## 1.0.0 (2026-10-27)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* appIconColor must be 0xRRGGBB ([b2ec434](https://github.com/alexandreL/morphe-patches/commit/b2ec4344d66cf2f9c03770a020c4abf655bf78da))

### ✨ New Features

* add Asana Rebel unlock Pro patch ([57f161a](https://github.com/alexandreL/morphe-patches/commit/57f161aaeb3a513c5a0b3337e580fe3a607d3c82))
* skip sign up/login and privacy consent screen ([90790d9](https://github.com/alexandreL/morphe-patches/commit/90790d986fc41b5267ed24167f882f9a0e692eea))

patches.name: Skip privacy consent screen
patches.description: A fresh guest account has no privacyPolicy/termsOfService flags, so the app would open the consent screen right after the splash. This disables that check.

patches.name: Skip sign up and login
patches.description: Lands on the home screen instead of the onboarding funnel: the app keeps using the anonymous guest account it already creates in the background.

patches.name: Unlock Asana Rebel Pro
patches.description: Makes the app always behave as if an active subscription exists: premium workouts, yoga stories, recipes, songs and downloads are unlocked.
